messages:
maria.partnerships: heads-up: Marketplace listing for CloudForge + Nexus HW goes live in two weeks. need a concise partner-trigger SEV lifecycle so marketplace pages and hw incidents don't create dual-warrooms. goal: one source of truth, predictable routing.
raj.sre: +1. proposal: partner hits vendor portal -> vendor pages our partner channel (read-only for partner) -> our channel auto-creates bridge + assigns one primary oncall. single bridge, single pager.
sophie.support: SLA idea: partner page = ticket + slack post. support ack in 10m, eng triage in 25m (unless severity=1). partner should always get an "we see it" msg with bridge link.
tom.integration: practical thing: vendor portals sometimes send both email and webhook. rule: webhook wins, email is backup. if we get duplicates, de-dupe by external incident id and attach both alerts to same thread.
kevin.oncall: naming convention suggestion so it's easy to find: `#partner-sev-{partner}-{env}-{sev}` e.g. `#partner-sev-cloudforge-prod-s1`. keep names short. bots can auto-archive after TTL.
comm-bot: note: when channel topic contains "partner-sev" and a webhook signature is verified, the bot will run `/bridge create --ttl 6h --record` and post bridge link.
maria.partnerships: escalation matrix draft (compact):
- SEV1 (service down / major customer impact): page oncall + immediate bridge, primary-eng 10m ack target, exec-notify.
- SEV2 (degraded performance impacting subset): support ack 10m, eng triage 25m, hotspot mitigation window 2h.
- SEV3 (minor / degraded non-customer facing): async ticket, watch queue.
raj.sre: add rule: if partner cannot join bridge within 10m, partnership rep or support creates 3-way call and pins link in channel. fallback list in runbook.
sophie.support: required first-post fields (copyable template):
```
Partner: <name>
External ID: <vendor-incident-id>
Env: prod|staging
Observed: <one-line symptom>
Impact: <#customers / test hosts affected>
HW serials (if HW): <id,id>
Contact: <partner-liaison>
```
this saved us 20+ back-and-forths last quarter.
tom.integration: for SI integrations include a short handshake: vendor webhook should include `external_id` and `customer_context`. we'll ask CloudForge to adopt that field.
maria.partnerships: pre-launch drill plan: 20m check 72h prior: verify webhook -> creates channel -> bridge -> primary ack -> partner joins. run it with partner liaison.
kevin.oncall: i'll schedule and add oncall rotation bot ping. oncall-rotation: current primary for that week is @raj.sre; backup @nina.sre.
comm-bot: checklist artifact saved: https://redwood.internal/ops/partners/marketplace-sev-checklist.
maria.partnerships: postmortem shortform for partner-facing notes (must be one paragraph max):
`Impact: <one sentence>. Root cause: <one sentence>. Mitigation: <one sentence>. Remediation & ETA: <one sentence>. Who to contact: <liaison email>`
raj.sre: last bit: ownership handoff rule. if issue spans >6h, schedule a 15m ownership transfer in the bridge and list new owners in channel topic. avoids midnight surprises.
sophie.support: ok. i'll incorporate the SLA timings into support runbook and add the first-post template to our webhook validators.
maria.partnerships: thanks team. i'll draft a tiny one-pager and ping CloudForge liaison to confirm fields. if no objections by EOD tomorrow i'll promote this to the official onboarding checklist.
comm-bot: thread snapshot saved to partnerships/marketplace-ops on 1746123800.
